# Pull Requests Are Not Currently Accepted

Boardfish is source-available, not open-source. External code contributions and
pull requests are not being accepted right now.

If you found a bug, have workflow feedback, or want to suggest a feature, please
open an issue instead:

- Bug report: `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md`
- Feedback: `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feedback.md`

Maintainer-only checklist:

- [ ] Ran `npm run check`
- [ ] Added or updated tests, or this change does not need tests
- [ ] Included screenshots or a screen recording for UI changes
- [ ] Updated release notes if needed
